fit_reason: Whole car, a 2018 Dodge Charger sedan, listed by a private owner in the cars by owner section.
findings: Paint on the doors, quarter panels and trunk looks reasonably glossy but slightly flat under the overcast light, with no strong reflections
Light dust and road film visible along the lower rocker panels and lower doors
Bronze wheels look a bit dull, with some brake dust visible on the faces
Black lower rear diffuser and exhaust surround look slightly grey and faded
Headlight lenses look a little hazy in the front three-quarter shot
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Charger. It looks to be in good shape, but the paint is a little flat in the photos and the black rear diffuser trim looks slightly faded. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a wash, polish and trim refresh, and we come to you. Would you like a quote?
